title: Government 'looking seriously' at banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay

claims.claim: Culture secretary Lisa Nandy said the government is looking seriously at banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay to keep children safe.

evidence.quote: Lisa Nandy said the government was "looking seriously" at including the retailing websites in the social media ban "in order to keep children safe".

claims.claim: The UK's social media ban for those under the age of 16 is set to come into force in March next year.

evidence.quote: The UK's social media ban for those under the age of 16 is set to come into force in March next year, with children barred from accessing platforms such as Instagram, TikTok and Snapchat.

claims.claim: Vinted has reached 17 million UK users.

evidence.quote: The site, which mostly sees users buy and sell unwanted clothes and other fashion items, has grown rapidly in recent times to reach 17 million UK users.

claims.claim: Both eBay and Vinted currently require their users to be at least 18 years old.

evidence.quote: The platform states on its website that it currently requires all of its members to be over 18 years old because listings involve "entering into a contract".
Vinted also says its users need to be at least 18 years old.

The platform states on its website that it currently requires all of its members to be over 18 years old because listings involve "entering into a contract". Vinted also says its users need to be at least 18 years old.

claims.claim: The government announced it would ban under-16s accessing social media in June this year, covering 10 of the biggest platforms.

evidence.quote: The government announced it would ban under-16s accessing social media in June this year, with children prevented from accessing 10 of the biggest platforms.

claims.claim: A similar social media ban for under-16s was introduced in Australia last year.

evidence.quote: The UK's ban comes after a similar one was introduced in Australia last year.

claims.claim: Roblox will not be banned for under-16s in the UK, but certain features such as its chat function will be restricted.

evidence.quote: It does not mean that Roblox, the biggest gaming site in the UK for eight to 12-year-olds for example, will be banned for under-16s. However, certain features such as its chat function will be restricted.

claims.claim: Last month, the communications regulator Ofcom set out its recommendations for identifying users aged over 16.

evidence.quote: Last month, the communications regulator Ofcom set out its recommendations for the most effective ways to identify which of the UK's millions of social media users are aged over 16.
